OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Shared API base URL. Shale appends /chat/completions for chat and /embeddings for embeddings. Role-specific base URLs or full endpoints override it.

OPENAI_CHAT_BASE_URL.description: Optional chat API base URL. Shale appends /chat/completions. When unset, OPENAI_BASE_URL is used.

EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.description: Optional embedding API base URL. Shale appends /embeddings. When unset, OPENAI_BASE_URL is used.

OPENAI_CHAT_ENDPOINT.description: Optional full chat request URL, including /chat/completions. Leave unset to derive it from the base URL.

EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT.description: Optional full embedding request URL, including /embeddings. Leave unset to derive it from the base URL.

OPENAI_CHAT_BATCH_ENDPOINT.description: Independent OpenAI-style chat Batch API URL ending in /batches. Files API is alongside it.

EMBEDDING_BATCH_ENDPOINT.description: Independent OpenAI-style embedding Batch API URL ending in /batches. Files API is alongside it.

OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Default embedding model. Changing models on a populated index requires reindexing.

MODEL_GPU_RESOURCE.description: Shared local GPU identity used to coordinate chat and embedding phases.

SHALE_DB_PATH.description: SQLite database path. Requires restarting the daemon. Relative paths are resolved from the project root.

CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Chat HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 300000 locally or 60000 remotely.

EMBEDDING_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Embedding HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 300000 locally or 60000 remotely.

MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Shared model HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

OPENAI_MAX_RETRIES.description: Number of HTTP retries. Defaults to 2 locally or 0 remotely.

OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT.description: Default chat reasoning effort. Empty string omits the control.

EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.description: Embedding storage padding and new/empty index dimensions. Populated indexes require explicit reindexing after changes.

OPENAI_CHAT_BATCH_MODE.description: Select bounded concurrent calls or the asynchronous OpenAI-style Batch API.

EMBEDDING_BATCH_MODE.description: Select bounded concurrent calls or the asynchronous OpenAI-style Batch API.

OPENAI_CHAT_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum concurrent synchronous chat requests per endpoint.

OPENAI_CHAT_BATCH_SIZE.description: Maximum chat preparation tasks per dedicated API batch.

EMBEDDING_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum concurrent synchronous embedding requests per endpoint.

EMBEDDING_BATCH_MAX_CHARS.description: Maximum padded characters per synchronous embedding request (longest text times input count). Larger individual texts run alone without truncation. Ignored by the asynchronous Batch API.

MODEL_BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Overall asynchronous Batch API deadline in milliseconds, independent of HTTP request timeouts.

MODEL_BATCH_POLL_INTERVAL_MS.description: Asynchronous Batch API polling interval in milliseconds.

PORT.description: Host HTTP port. Requires restarting the daemon.

SHALE_QUEUE_VIEWER_PORT.description: Browser queue viewer HTTP port. Requires restarting the viewer.

SHALE_MCP_PORT.description: Knowledge Graph MCP HTTP server port. Requires restarting the daemon.
